evidence.title: General Translation: Full-stack localization for the world's best companies

name: General Translation
summary: Localization platform for developers: open-source i18n SDKs, context-aware AI translation and the Locadex coding agent.
description: Full-stack internationalization platform: translatable content lives in application code instead of extracted strings or a separate TMS, and translations are generated with context from component structure, variable names and product glossaries. Open-source SDKs cover Next.js, React, React Native, TanStack Start, Vue, Node.js and Python, plus a CLI, REST API and MCP server. Locadex, its AI agent, scans repositories, updates source code, generates translations and opens pull requests. Starter is free with usage-based billing; Enterprise adds SSO, RBAC and SOC 2.
contains: open-source SDKs: gt-next, gt-react, gt-react-native, gt-vue, gt-node, Python and the gt CLI
Locadex agent scans repos, updates source code, generates translations and opens pull requests
context-aware translation using component structure, variable names and a product glossary
content sources: GitHub, Google Drive, Figma, Contentful, Sanity, Mintlify and Markdown
120+ locales; numbers, currencies, dates and plurals; locale-aware routing
pre-generated translations delivered through production CDN infrastructure
free Starter plan with usage-based billing; Enterprise adds SSO, RBAC, SOC 2 and ISO 27001
used by Cursor, Ramp, Mintlify, Profound, Partiful and ClickHouse
